item.title: H.S. BASKETBALL: District 2 playoff games postponed
item.description: The winter storm that reached Northeastern Pennsylvania on Sunday has impacted the District 2-4 boys’ basketball tournament schedule. Both of Monday’s Class 6A semifinals — Hazleton Area at Wilkes-Barre Area and Delaware Valley at Williamsport — were pushed backed to Tuesday at 7 and 6 p.m., respectively. The winners will advance to the subregional championship game on Saturday at 8 p.m. at Mohegan Arena. Fans who purchased a ticket for the original Monday date can used that ticket for admission
